rows.text: After obtaining the divine treasure from the ancient tomb, you've been through countless adventures: Rescuing a refugee mother and child from Black Tide Creatures, helping the Grove transport endangered plant seeds, and even briefly getting involved in the strife between Castrum Kremnos and Okhema. The treasure always proves useful.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: One night, you sit by the lake at the foot of the snowy mountain, toying with the divine treasure. The moon is hidden behind thick clouds, with only a few dim rays of light seeping through.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Thou hast proven thyself worthy." A gentle whisper drifts by your ear, from one of the Gods of Three Fates, unknown which. "Thy virtue shall add strength to the treasure."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You make a request to the voice. The thick clouds part, and gentle moonlight pours down, revealing something at your feet...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You humbly decline this power. The thick clouds disperse as gentle moonlight pours down. When you open your eyes, the divine treasure has vanished, but something is left at your feet.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
